reusableConstructedKernel: SourceFPrimeStripPullbackLiftCandidate composes a selected source isomorphism with a projection and proves that forgetting the composite recovers the represented D-arrow.
The selected F-poly-arrow is derived as the range of the reconstructed lifts; nonemptiness and the associated-D existence statement are then proved.
Definition 5.5 bridge isomorphism members retain their D-level representative and derive the selected F-level components, avoiding caller-supplied bijectivity fields.
Identity, composition, associated-D maps, and the resulting equivalences on the selected member types are constructed once all recognition inputs are supplied.
interfaceBoundary: Every F-prime-strip pullback starts from SourceFPrimeStripPullbackLiftRecognition.candidate_exists and candidates_equivalent; the commit does not construct the pullback from initial theta data.
The global Frobenioids, their restriction diagram, each local-to-global F-lift, theater isomorphisms, and F-theta bridge isomorphisms are all selected from recognition records by Classical.choice.

The selected F-poly-arrow is defined as the range of one canonical selected lift per represented D-arrow. Its uniqueness theorem is therefore a theorem about that selected range, not a construction or uniqueness proof for every source-valid pullback realization.
Definition 5.5(iii) common-capsule gluing is explicitly absent.

intersectionWithLocalWork.result: The local theorem proves a stronger multiplicative, Galois-equivariant, times-mu exact-image comparison for the concrete Q_p integral-unit carrier. It does not yet provide the upstream embedding into the reconstructed infinity-kappa-times pseudo-monoid, its integral ind-system comparison, or the initial-theta selected-place type bridge.

decision: Do not port this branch now. Reuse the pullback-lift and D-to-F member architecture only after the project has constructed the exact Definition 5.5 recognition hypotheses from its initial-theta and Frobenioid objects.
impactOnCLayer: Useful future architecture for F_NF and F_theta bridges, but no immediate closure of universal-cover Frobenioid evaluation, Definition 4.9 group reconstruction, initial theta data, Hodge theaters, theta-links, or log-links.
impactOnTheorem311Corollary312: No direct discharge of the IUT-specific multiradial output, Ind1-Ind3, IPL, SHE, APT, holomorphic hull, determinant/tensor normalization, or actual log-volume comparison.
